optimizedDescription.value: Translates Go code (.go) into package-aware symbols, scoped facts, imports, selector calls, composite literals, and interface satisfaction.

optimizedContext.value:
# go-language-adapter

## Rules

### Scope & Analysis
- Handles `.go` as `go`.
- Single-pass parsing via Tree-sitter/ast-grep; outputs `FileAnalysisDraft` without AST retention or Go toolchain execution.

### Declarations & Owners
- Extracts functions, receiver methods, struct types (class kind), interface types (interface kind), named types/aliases (type kind), vars, consts.
- Complete construct range; declared-name `selectionRange`. Attached comments preserved.
- Declaring owner = receiver type (normalized pointer syntax) or interface. Same-name methods distinct across types. Package functions/types/consts have no owner.
- Uppercase identifiers -> public export bindings; lowercase -> non-exported.

### Imports & Package Resolution
- Extracts single, grouped, aliased, dot, and blank imports (blank -> file dependency without symbol binding).
- Resolves import specifiers by longest `go.mod` module prefix bounded by repo root.

### Scoped Bindings, Calls & Relations
- Emits facts for scope, typed params/results, receiver bindings, selector expressions, composite literals, constructor calls.
- Emits `IMPORTS`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE` only when proven by package/receiver/import facts.
- Drops unresolved selectors, reflection, dynamic interface dispatch, uninstantiated generics.

### Embedding & Interface Satisfaction
- Embedded named interface -> `EXTENDS`. Reference facts retain child owner, embedded owner, relation kind, provenance steps.
- Emits `IMPLEMENTS` only when concrete receiver-method facts prove full interface method set (pointer/value receiver rules enforced; NO empty method sets / name-only guesses).
- Member-level `OVERRIDES` unsupported. Bounded cycle termination.
- Advertises `hierarchy: true`, `buildContext: false`.

### Build Boundary
- `go.work`, `replace`, vendoring, `internal/`, build tags (`GOOS`/`GOARCH`), cgo unsupported -> remains `unresolved`/`ambiguous`.

## Constraints
- NO `go list`, compiler execution, or runtime reflection.
- Speculative interface satisfaction, build tag guesswork -> prohibited.
- Go-specific package/receiver/method-set logic MUST stay inside adapter.
